about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the music of Power Sink with this original soundtrack by composer Oliver “Mighty Muso” Proslmeyr. Carefully reworked for an immersive standalone listening experience, the soundtrack features enriched and extended arrangements, inviting listeners to follow the Diver's journey through a vast, unfamiliar landscape as they race to restore power to their failing colony.

Drawing inspiration from Donkey Kong Country, Subnautica, and Abzû, the score blends organic soundscapes, sweeping orchestral arrangements, and rich electronic textures. From the hopeful clarity and heroic energy of the Sunny Reef to the dark and foreboding depths of the Hadal Crater, each track paints a vivid picture of a decaying power grid swallowed by the ocean of an alien world.
